tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gdams pa 'di rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i le'u bcu dgu pa na bzhugs/ tshogs kyi bdag po dmar po sgrub par 'dod pas/ skar ma rgyal la bab pa'i tshe/ lha bzo ba shin tu mkhas pas/ ras mtho gang gru bzhi la sku nyin gcig la tshar bar bri'o// de nas gnas yid du 'ong bar tshogs bsog la sogs pa sngon du byas la mtshams bcad/ stegs pu gru bzhi pa'i steng du/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po bris te/ dbus su zla gam dmar po bya'o// de'i steng du rten gtor bzang po gcig bzhag la de la bris sku gzugs/ mdun du rgyun gtor dang pū dza lnga bsham/ de'i mdun du rang 'dug la/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsog pa sdon du song nas/ rang mi dmigs pa las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad sku mdog mthing ga rab tu khros pa/ skra ser po/ spyan gsum pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ thod pa'i rgyan yod pa/ ro dang nyi ma'i steng na zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos thugs kar rdo rje bsnams pa/ g.yon dang pos thod pa thugs kar bzung pa/ 'og ma gnyis rgyab nas mda' gzhu 'gengs par bdag nyid bsgoms la/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ sum+bha ni ci rigs shig bzlas la/ de nas mdun gyi pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kyi gdan la me ri dang*/ brag ri dang*/ byi sngon gyi steng du/ gaḥdamar po gyur pa las/ bris sku de tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dmar po glang gi gdong can/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs g.yon du cung zad 'phyar ba/ phyag bcu gnyis yod pa'i g.yas drug na rim pa bzhin/ dgra s+t+wa/ mda'/ lcags kyu/

rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'phang mdung*/ g.yon drug na/ gtun shing*/ gzhu/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ thod pa sha chen gyis bkang ba/ rtse gsum la phub dang ba dan bsdebs pa btags pa'o// gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer dmar po 'phro bar bsgom mo/ de'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ sum cu rtsa gsum dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ tshogs bdag spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs dam tshig pa la bstim/ de nas dgug sngags brgya bzlas so// oṃ gaḥg ṇa/ sid+dhi sid+dhi/ sarba ar+tha me pra sā dhā ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ zhes pas bkug la/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas gdan dbul lo// spos sna tshogs dang me tog dmar pos mchod/ pū dza dang rgyun gtor dbul lo// de nas bzlas pa bya'o// oṃ āḥg hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa 'bum bzlas/ skabs su mchod pa dang gtor ma dbul/ rten gtor ni byin rlabs gzhan dang 'dra/ bsnyen sngags ni a kā ro btags la dbul lo// mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ de ltar byas pas sngags pa brjid can mthong na dga' rmi lam du la phug ster ba'am/ nor ma bslang bar ster ba'am/ 'bru'i phung po'am/ shing skam po spungs pa rmi na grub pa'i rtags yin/ grub rtags byung na kho la gtang rag khas blang*/ 'bum phrag gcig po song ba dang*/ mchil mas dpral bar thig le bya/ de nas las gang bsgrub pa dang*/ bsnyen sngags stong bzlas la gang 'dod bya'o// de ltar bsgrubs pa'i sngags pa de thams cad kyis mthong na dga' dang yid du 'ong bar 'gyur ro// rgyal pos rgyal po bzhin du mchod cing 'dzin par 'gyur ro// dgra thams cad 'chi ste lan tshwa chur bcug pa bzhin no// bgegs thams cad bsrung ngo*// las thams cad grub cing nor thams cad ster bar 'gyur ro// ji skad smras pa'i tshig gis mi rnams yid ches so// kho ye ma grub na/

rang khro bor bsgoms pa'i rkang pa'i 'og tu tshogs bdag bcug la mnan par bsam zhing sngags bzlas/ des the tshom med par 'grub bo// tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs i thi// //'di la sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ dang por pad 'dab brgyad dmar po zla gam dang bcas pa bya ste/ de'i steng du tsan+dan nam/ shug pa'i shing brtsigs la/ de'i dbus su tshogs bdag gi sku bris pa ltar bskyed la dgug gzhug bya'o// bsreg rdzas ni gro'i bag phye la mngar gsum bsres pa sen kha res dbul/ rtsa sngags la dgug sngags btags pa dang*/ de la a kā ro btags pas dbul lo// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsam/ 'bru sna tshogs dang*/ rin po che dang*/ dar zab sna tshogs dbul/ zhal zas rnams zhal du dbul bar bsam/ 'bru dang rat+na lag tu/ dar zab gos dang bla re dang gdan du dbul lo// mnyes nas 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa bdag la byin par bsam/ gtor ma dang pū dza lnga yang dbul/ gang 'dod gsol ba drag tu gdab bo// bstod pa bya/ thab kyi lha mi dmigs par bsam mo// tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ shākya'i dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o// shin tu zab i thi// //'di'i zhal gdams ni/ dben pa'i gnas su tsan+dan dang*/ du ru ska dang*/ si la dang*/ ga pur la sogs pa'i spos dang*/ me tog dmar pos mchod/ sngags bzlas/ gtor ma phul la gsol ba drag tu gdab/ sku mi la bstan na dngos grub yal 'gro bas mi bstan/ sngags thun 'bum song ba dang*/ 'gugs sngags btags la 'bum bzlas so// grub rtags ma byung na gnad la dbab pa gong bzhin bya'o// nag po pas byas pa'i sgrub thabs gcig kyang 'dug ste/ sa skya pa'i 'di rang legs pa 'dug go /yid ches pa'i lo rgyus mang du yod de ma bris so// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
